“I'm still here.”
First, my heart

An apology I mean.

Shunuu, I'm sorry. ❤️

When I learned things about your past, at first I felt really sad, angry, hurt and insecure. I was overwhelmed, and some of my words came from that pain.

Those harsh words hurt you, and I'm genuinely sorry. You were brave enough to tell me something you were afraid to tell me. You didn't deserve to feel even more scared or guilty afterward.

After I calmed down, I realized something important: your life before me was not mine to rewrite. I don't want to punish you for having a past. I don't want my insecurity to become your punishment.

I may need time to heal from what I learned. I won't pretend otherwise. But I'll work on myself, communicate instead of lashing out, and learn to separate my fear from the person you are with me today.

I never wanted to make you cry. I only wanted to see your beautiful smile.

I'm sorry, Shunuu. I love you. Always trying to love you better — Chidvilash ❤️

Our promise

Honesty over fear.

From here, I want us to make a promise to each other:

❤️ No deliberately hiding important things.
❤️ No lying because we're afraid.
❤️ When something hurts, we talk.
❤️ When one of us is scared, the other listens.
❤️ When we make mistakes, we repair.
❤️ We respect each other's boundaries and individuality.
❤️ We don't use the past as a weapon.

I'd rather hear a difficult truth than live inside a beautiful lie.

And I promise to make it safer for you to be honest with me by learning to respond with patience instead of reacting from fear.

Chidvilash 🤍 Shunuu

The promise I want to live

I don't want your world to revolve around me.

I want to be the person standing beside you while you conquer your own world.

I want to watch you become stronger, happier and more confident. I want to celebrate your achievements without making them about me.

Your dreams matter. My dreams matter. And the dreams we choose together matter too.

I'll cheer for your handstands, your splits, your Taekwondo, your NCC, your studies, your future career and every new thing you decide to learn.

And I hope you'll cheer for me too.

For my Shunuu

We choose us.

I don't need the girl who has never made mistakes.
I want you.

You, with your laughter. Your dreams. Your strength. Your weirdness. Your softness. Your fears. Your courage. Your pagal moments. The girl who keeps becoming more of herself.

I can't change what came before us. But we can choose what happens next.

I'm here. I'm learning. I'm healing. I'm choosing to build.

And if life keeps taking us in the same direction, I want to keep walking beside you — hand in hand — through every chapter we get to write.

Just you & me. ❤️
